summary: HISTLD00 is a batch program that loads position/transaction history from a VSAM file (TRANSACTION-HISTORY) into the DB2 POSHIST table. It opens the history and batch-control files, connects to DB2, and marks the control record active. It then reads history records sequentially and, for each, maps the fields onto a POSHIST row and INSERTs it into DB2; it counts written rows, treats a duplicate-key (SQLCODE -803) as a skip, and routes other SQL errors to a DB2 error routine. It commits every 1000 rows and updates a checkpoint (read/written counts) in the control file so the load is restartable. The main loop stops at end-of-file OR after 100 errors. At termination it does a final commit + checkpoint, closes files, disconnects DB2, and prints statistics; the job return code is the error count. Errors trigger ERRPROC plus a DB2 ROLLBACK.

paragraphs.name: 0000-MAIN
paragraphs.pseudocode:
CALL 1000-INITIALIZE
WHILE NOT end of file AND WS-ERROR-COUNT <= 100 DO
  CALL 2000-PROCESS
END WHILE
CALL 3000-TERMINATE
SET job RETURN-CODE = WS-ERROR-COUNT
RETURN to caller (GOBACK)
branches: WHILE NOT END-OF-FILE OR WS-ERROR-COUNT > 100 (loop guard with an error cap)

annotations.note: The loop has a safety cap: it aborts after more than 100 errors, not just at end-of-file.

paragraphs.name: 1100-OPEN-FILES
paragraphs.pseudocode:
OPEN TRANSACTION-HISTORY for READ-ONLY
IF status <> '00' THEN SET error 'Error opening history file'; CALL 9000-ERROR-ROUTINE END IF
OPEN BATCH-CONTROL-FILE for READ-WRITE (I-O)
IF status <> '00' THEN SET error 'Error opening control file'; CALL 9000-ERROR-ROUTINE END IF

paragraphs.name: 1200-CONNECT-DB2
paragraphs.pseudocode: CALL CONNECT-TO-DB2   -- routine defined in the DBPROC copybook

annotations.note: CONNECT-TO-DB2 is a paragraph brought in via the DBPROC copybook (shared DB2 connect logic).

paragraphs.name: 1300-INIT-CHECKPOINTS
paragraphs.pseudocode:
SET BCT-KEY = spaces; SET BCT-JOB-NAME = 'HISTLD00'
READ BATCH-CONTROL-FILE by key
IF record not found THEN SET error 'Control record not found'; CALL 9000-ERROR-ROUTINE END IF
SET BCT-STATUS = active
REWRITE the control record
paragraphs.notes: Marks the job active in the shared batch-control record.

paragraphs.name: 2000-PROCESS
paragraphs.pseudocode:
CALL 2100-READ-HISTORY
IF more records THEN
  CALL 2200-LOAD-TO-DB2
  CALL 2300-CHECK-COMMIT
END IF

paragraphs.name: 2100-READ-HISTORY
paragraphs.pseudocode:
READ next record from TRANSACTION-HISTORY
IF end of file THEN SET END-OF-FILE = true
ELSE INCREMENT WS-RECORDS-READ
END IF
branches: READ ... AT END / NOT AT END

paragraphs.name: 2200-LOAD-TO-DB2
paragraphs.pseudocode:
CLEAR POSHIST-RECORD
COPY each history field onto the matching POSHIST column (account, portfolio, date/time, type, security, quantity, price, amount, fees, total, cost basis, gain/loss)
SQL INSERT INTO POSHIST VALUES (:POSHIST-RECORD)
IF SQLCODE = 0 THEN
  INCREMENT WS-RECORDS-WRITTEN
ELSE IF SQLCODE = -803 THEN
  CONTINUE          -- duplicate key: skip, not an error
ELSE
  INCREMENT WS-ERROR-COUNT
  CALL DB2-ERROR-ROUTINE
END IF

annotations.note: Whole-row INSERT via a host-variable record (:POSHIST-RECORD) — the POSHIST copybook layout must match the table column order exactly.
SQLCODE -803 = duplicate primary key; handled by CONTINUE (silently skipped, not counted as written or error) — an idempotent-reload design.

paragraphs.name: 2300-CHECK-COMMIT
paragraphs.pseudocode:
INCREMENT WS-COMMIT-COUNT
IF WS-COMMIT-COUNT >= 1000 (threshold) THEN
  SQL COMMIT WORK
  RESET WS-COMMIT-COUNT = 0
  CALL 2310-UPDATE-CHECKPOINT
END IF

annotations.note: Commits every 1000 rows to bound the DB2 unit of work and enable restart from the last checkpoint.

paragraphs.name: 2310-UPDATE-CHECKPOINT
paragraphs.pseudocode:
SET BCT-RECORDS-READ = WS-RECORDS-READ
SET BCT-RECORDS-WRITTEN = WS-RECORDS-WRITTEN
REWRITE the batch-control record
IF invalid key THEN SET error 'Error updating checkpoint'; CALL 9000-ERROR-ROUTINE END IF
paragraphs.notes: Persists progress counts so the load can resume.

paragraphs.name: 3100-FINAL-COMMIT
paragraphs.pseudocode:
SQL COMMIT WORK          -- commit the final partial batch
CALL 2310-UPDATE-CHECKPOINT

paragraphs.name: 3300-DISCONNECT-DB2
paragraphs.pseudocode: CALL DISCONNECT-FROM-DB2   -- routine from the DBPROC copybook

paragraphs.name: 3400-DISPLAY-STATS
paragraphs.pseudocode: DISPLAY 'HISTLD00 Processing Statistics:' with records read, records written, and error count

paragraphs.name: 9000-ERROR-ROUTINE
paragraphs.pseudocode:
SET ERR-PROGRAM = 'HISTLD00'
CALL 'ERRPROC' PASSING ERR-MESSAGE
SQL ROLLBACK WORK       -- undo the current uncommitted unit of work

annotations.note: On any error it ROLLBACKs the DB2 work since the last commit — up to 1000 rows may be undone.
